user.title: Tuya/AVATTO Matter Thermostat Relay
user.description:
Shows whether the relay of Tuya-based Matter thermostats is switched on, i.e. whether the heating is actually running. The HA Matter integration does not provide this value because it lives in a Tuya manufacturer cluster.

**Tested with:** WT410 Matter (micuda / AVATTO, Matter vendor MIUC).

**How it works:** the integration listens to the Matter Server and receives changes instantly through the existing Matter subscription, no polling. A "Heating" sensor is added automatically to every matching thermostat device, including thermostats commissioned later.

The URL is usually the same as the Matter integration's.
